selection_criterion: erc_regime Sharpe on the real universe
notes: RESOLVED 2026-09-27 -- re-derived on validation-only data (2015-01-02 to 2018-12-31, final-test window never enters the series at all; see scripts/run_refit_cadence_validation_check.py and outputs/refit_cadence_validation_comparison.csv), per AnnaLisa's M3 review request. Same comparison basis as the original choice (matches/beats the no-refit baseline on erc_regime Sharpe): no_refit=0.405, monthly=0.386 (underperforms the no-refit baseline), quarterly=0.409 (matches/beats it). Quarterly is confirmed on legitimate validation-only evidence, not just the previously-contaminated comparison -- M2's monthly spec is superseded by this validation result, not retained as default. UPDATE 2026-10-22 -- the SLSQP risk-budget solve left an asset at zero weight in erc_regime on 3 validation dates in the no-refit arm and 1 in the quarterly arm (docs/verification/solver_and_accounting_checks.md, section 6). With the exact solver the three arms are no_refit=0.386, monthly=0.386, quarterly=0.383: none matches or beats the no-refit baseline, the earlier +0.004 margin came from the solver failures, and the paired bootstrap interval for quarterly minus no-refit is [-0.038, +0.032]. Quarterly remains the pre-specified specification (it is what the frozen reference uses), but validation evidence does not favour it over monthly or no refit. The original SLSQP values are preserved in outputs/refit_cadence_validation_comparison.csv.
